integrity: Analytic continuum proof with reproducible supplementary finite-direction and derivative checks; first public date refers to motivating publication, not a publication date for this result.
scientific_limitations: Exact statement only for planar Euclidean equilateral-triangle outer offsets and two nonparallel segment test bodies; no unrestricted Bézout coefficient, no independent validation, unresolved unindexed priority risk.
title: Nonmonotone sharp two-segment Bézout profile of rounded equilateral triangles
